name: When should I use an investment property market report instead of a standard appraisal?

mainEntity.name: When should I use an investment property market report instead of a standard appraisal?

acceptedAnswer.text: An investment property market report provides a broad overview of market trends and potential for a region or property type, useful for strategic planning and identifying investment opportunities. A standard appraisal offers a precise valuation of a specific property at a given time, essential for securing financing or making an offer. You would use a market report when initially researching areas like Palm Beach or considering different asset classes, and an appraisal once you've identified a specific property. This process clarity helps guide your investment journey, ensuring you use the right tool at the right stage.
